wedo_instance.description: The synchronous collaboration HUD for agent incarnation and forensic synchronization.

meta.philosophy: The WeDo is the irreducible serial thread that synchronizes the agent's async capacity with the human's single-threaded focus.
meta.pre_flight_instruction: DO NOT MARK UP THIS BOILERPLATE. Perform steps 1-2 first, then copy this file to the day's chrono-fractal as '[SESSION_ID]_[NAME]_startup.wedo.json' and mark your progress there.

rules.accumulation: Word count must ALWAYS increase in each iteration.
rules.temporal_instance: Never work in global templates; copy to day's json/ directory.
rules.audit_scrutiny: List all changes/requests from source for verifiable history.
rules.active_investigation: Verify artifact existence on localhost before inclusion.
rules.dual_referencing: Reference both localhost paths and remotehost URLs.
rules.audit_trail_linking: Daily session WeDos MUST link to specific project WeDos to maintain a forensic audit trail.
rules.output_location: All active task instances and WeDo reports MUST reside in the day's temporal json/ directory per Substrate-First mandate.
rules.finalization_protocol: The goal is to refine 'md/' artifacts into permanent Heartwood. Renaming occurs ONLY upon explicit request.
rules.versioning_archival: When updating Markdown documents, move old versions to memory/trash/ per Surgical Deletion mandate.
rules.substrate_primacy: Primary state lives in JSON/PY. Markdown is a curated reflection child.
rules.family_linking: Every JSON parent MUST explicitly note its MD reflection name.

tasks.description: Baseline Confirmation: Confirm 'py/verify_environment.py' and 'py/metagit_map.py' success in the Meta-Root.
Metadata Acquisition: Claim the session via the latest metadata in 'dynamic/static/'.
HUD Instantiation: Copy this manifest to the chrono-fractal and sync focus with the Lead Partner.
Identity Anchoring (syn): Run 'py/register_agent.py' to anchor the meta-root identity. MANDATE: Use --repo and --force-takeover if necessary to break collision loops.
Forensic Trace: Synthesize recent snapshots. RECOVERY: Consult the V8.0 Journey (The Agent-Led Strike) for active mission chord.
